metadata.purpose: After successful source completion, synchronously append a finite word of supplied values.

conditions: On success, emitted word is the source word concatenated with the finite suffix word.
An error or explicit cancellation does not append the suffix. No suffix value is emitted before source completion.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, resource release and cancellation are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: Finite fixed suffix of 2 values, no deprecated SchedulerLike overload.
scope.callbacks: None. Values are opaque, including undefined and object identity.
scope.time: Source timing preserved; suffix is delivered synchronously at normal completion, without scheduling.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source and callback outcome delivery; no observer/finalizer reentry inside the modeled reaction.
exclusions: Deprecated scheduler overload and implicit scheduled suffix semantics.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One independently owned source connection is acquired at subscription, not construction.

ownership.sharing: None; independent operator state per subscription even if the upstream happens to be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh subscription starts with new state; closed execution rejects all subsequent model inputs.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Source completes then is released; suffix microsteps emit in order and finally complete. No timer or sharing.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications or completed synchronous logical microsteps; silent release only.
